prompt: The pale fountain jets surge upward and shatter into thousands of separate droplets, each one hanging in the air before it falls back into the churning pool. The camera stays locked in a tight close shot. Soft daylight catches the spray and turns it milky white. Extreme slow motion, weightless.
title: Fountain Burst

prompt: Green ink rolls through the water in thick folding clouds, the pale core at the bottom of the frame swelling outward and curling into a slow spiral. The camera drifts forward a few centimetres into the cloud. Light from above glows through the thinner veils. Super slow motion, dreamlike and deep.
title: Emerald Bloom

prompt: The diagonal bands of blue, magenta and deep red light slide across the frame like passing beams, while the soft pink orb at the left pulses and drifts upward. The camera tilts slowly along the direction of the streaks. Colours bleed into one another at the edges. Smooth, liquid, late-night mood.
title: Neon Sweep

prompt: The glowing orange orb spins in place and flings its trail of pink particles out across the dark in a long curling arc, each speck fading as it travels. The camera tracks slowly right, following the stream. The orb throws a warm halo into the black around it. Slow, cosmic, quietly intense.
title: Comet Trail

prompt: The man in sunglasses shakes his head and the teal powder in his hair explodes outward in a fine cloud, grains scattering from his shoulders in every direction. The camera holds a steady close-up at chest height. A hard side light picks out each particle against the dark backdrop. Super slow motion, defiant.
title: Powder Shake

prompt: The large soft discs of peach and green light swell, overlap and slide past one another, new circles fading in from the blurred background as others dissolve. The camera drifts gently sideways without ever finding focus. The glow breathes brighter and dimmer in a slow rhythm. Hazy, calm, half-asleep.
title: Bokeh Drift

prompt: Above the dark roofline and tree silhouettes, each short streak of starlight stretches into a long curved line as the whole sky wheels around an unseen pole. The camera stays fixed on a tripod. The trails brighten while the foreground remains pure shadow. Time-lapse, vast and patient.
title: Star Trails

prompt: Cars on the elevated road below dissolve into continuous ribbons of white and red light that pour between the tower blocks, while windows flick on and off across the facades. The camera glides forward high above the street. Orange streetlamps flood the tarmac. Hyperlapse, restless city pulse.
title: Traffic Streaks

prompt: The grey ground wraps tighter around the small sphere at the centre and the whole miniature world begins to rotate, parked vehicles sliding around its rim like the hands of a clock. The camera spirals slowly down towards it. Flat monochrome light keeps every texture crisp. Surreal, toy-like, hypnotic.
title: Tiny Planet Spin

prompt: A shiver passes through the bed of silver glitter and the flakes lift, tumble and resettle, each one flashing as it turns. The camera slides slowly down the frame in macro close-up with a very shallow focus. Points of light bloom into soft white discs and vanish. Slow motion, icy and glamorous.
title: Silver Shimmer

prompt: The soap bubbles wobble and drift upward through the frame, their skins swirling with thin rainbow film, and a few burst into a fine mist of droplets. The camera rises with them at the same gentle pace. Sunlight filtering through the green leaves behind glints on every curve. Slow motion, light and playful.
title: Bubble Float

prompt: The blue paint pushes into the salmon pink in a slow tide, its white veins stretching into fine marbled loops that curl and fold along the boundary. The camera moves across the surface in a top-down glide. Even soft light gives the wet paint a glossy sheen. Fluid, unhurried, deeply satisfying.
title: Marble Flow

prompt: The dancer's silhouette sweeps her arms through the pose and leaves a fading trail of darker echoes behind every movement, her reflection rippling on the glossy floor. The camera pushes in slowly from full length. The red backdrop pulses brighter with each gesture. Slow motion, bold and theatrical.
title: Crimson Echo

prompt: The skater's feet roll across the smooth concrete and the long shadow beneath the board stretches and swings as the wheels carve a wide arc. The camera follows low to the ground, just behind the board. Hard afternoon sun bleaches the surface almost white. Slow motion, effortless summer cool.
title: Shadow Glide

prompt: The white plumes sink and roll through the dark water like heavy smoke, each curl splitting into finer wisps that hook back on themselves above the dense bank below. The camera holds a locked-off medium shot. Side light gives the folds a soft pearly edge. Super slow motion, ghostly.
title: Smoke Curl

prompt: The blue-lit walls of the tunnel streak past as the view accelerates along the pale central walkway, ribs and panels blurring into radial lines around the vanishing point. The camera flies straight forward, gathering speed. The blue light strobes in waves down the passage. Fast, immersive, futuristic.
title: Tunnel Rush

prompt: The yellow daffodil opens wider, its petals peeling back one by one and the trumpet flaring towards the lens while the stem sways slightly. The camera eases in from a centred mid shot to a close-up. A single soft light isolates the flower against pure black. Time-lapse, delicate and quiet.
title: Daffodil Unfold

prompt: The loose cloud of pink and blue confetti drifts down through the darkness, pieces spinning on their own axes and catching the light as they turn edge-on. The camera tilts down slowly with the fall. A narrow beam from above makes each flake flash and fade. Slow motion, celebratory hush.
title: Confetti Rain

prompt: A swell rises out of the dark blue sea and breaks over the rocks in the foreground, throwing a wall of white spray high into the frame before it drains back through the cracks. The camera sits low and steady at water level. Flat overcast light keeps the water steel-toned. Slow motion, powerful and cold.
title: Wave Crash

prompt: The magenta light ribbons whip and loop through the frame, thin white-hot filaments crossing over the glowing pink core as it folds in on itself. The camera rotates slowly around the centre. Every streak leaves a soft violet afterglow in its wake. Fluid, electric, club-night energy.
title: Neon Ribbons

prompt: The round swarm of red-orange particles breathes in and out, contracting to a dense glowing core and then bursting outward to fill the frame again. The camera pushes slowly through the outer specks towards the middle. Each particle flares brighter as it nears the lens. Pulsing, warm, hypnotic.
title: Ember Swarm

prompt: The row of flames sways and stretches against the black, tongues of yellow tearing free at their tips and curling into nothing. The camera stays still in a tight frontal shot. The fire is the only light source, its bright cores fading to deep orange at the edges. Super slow motion, primal.
title: Flame Dance

prompt: A cloud of coloured powder bursts across the man in sunglasses from both sides, coating his T-shirt and hanging around his head in drifting green and yellow veils while he stays perfectly still. The camera dollies in towards his face. Cool side light cuts through the dust. Slow motion, cinematic swagger.
title: Powder Burst

prompt: The cluster of orange discs floats apart and regroups on the black background, each orb swelling, dimming and sliding behind the next. The camera racks focus back and forth so the circles grow and shrink. Their glow warms to gold at the brightest points. Slow, intimate, candlelit.
title: Amber Orbs

prompt: Every star in the deep blue field draws itself into a lengthening arc, the short dashes joining up until the sky is combed with fine concentric lines. The camera tilts very slowly upward. The blue deepens towards the corners as the trails grow brighter. Time-lapse, silent and immense.
title: Sky Wheel

prompt: Headlights race down the long straight overpass towards the horizon as unbroken white streams, while the lit roads on either side smear into bands of orange. The camera flies forward along the centre line. Sodium lamps wash the whole district in amber. Hyperlapse, fast and relentless.
title: Highway Hyperlapse

prompt: The drone hovers at the centre of the frame, rotors blurring, while the grey landscape curled around it turns like a whirlpool and the pale disc beneath it slowly revolves. The camera twists in the opposite direction to the ground. Stark monochrome light sharpens every ridge. Dizzying, strange, precise.
title: Drone Vortex

prompt: Gold glitter and tiny sequins slide down the pale surface in a slow avalanche, grains rolling over each other and throwing off pinpoint flashes. The camera tracks with the slide in a shallow-focus macro shot. Warm light turns the out-of-focus specks into soft golden discs. Slow motion, rich and festive.
title: Gold Dust

prompt: The cluster of clear bubbles on the grey paint swells and crowds together, smaller domes merging into larger ones until one pops and sends a ripple through the surface. The camera hovers directly overhead and creeps closer. Soft window light sits as a highlight on each dome. Macro, slow, oddly soothing.
title: Bubble Swell

prompt: The streak of white paint stretches and thins as it is drawn across the coral-pink surface, feathering at the edges into pale threads that sink into the colour beneath. The camera glides slowly along the streak in close-up. Diffused light gives the paint a satin gloss. Slow, creamy, tactile.
title: Coral Pour

prompt: The vertical light tubes at the back of the dark teal hall flicker on in sequence and their reflections ripple across the glossy floor like water disturbed by a step. The camera pushes slowly forward between the columns. Cyan light spreads and recedes through the haze. Moody, spacious, cinematic.
title: Light Ripple

prompt: The skater crouches, pops the board off the smooth ground and hangs in mid-air above it as the deck rotates under his feet, then lands and rolls on. The camera circles him low with a wide-angle lens that bends the buildings behind. Soft overcast light keeps the scene pale. Slow motion, loose and confident.
title: Board Pop

prompt: The rows of blue and violet light dashes rush outward from the centre point, stretching into long streaks as the tunnel seems to accelerate around the viewer. The camera drives straight in with a slow roll. The vanishing point flares white, then settles. Fast, synthetic, science-fiction.
title: Warp Tunnel

prompt: The red amaryllis trumpets spread fully open, petals arching back and stamens lifting forward, while the buds behind them swell on the stem. The camera orbits a quarter turn around the flower head. Soft frontal light keeps the reds saturated against the black. Time-lapse, lush and deliberate.
title: Scarlet Bloom

prompt: Bright paper confetti tumbles down in front of the olive green curtain, pieces flipping and side-slipping so their colours flash red, blue and yellow as they turn. The camera tilts down slowly along the folds of fabric. Soft daylight leaves faint shadows on the cloth. Slow motion, cheerful.
title: Confetti Flutter

prompt: A stone breaks the still lake surface and rings spread outward across the frame, bending the reflection of the golden autumn branches into wavering bands. The camera holds a steady high angle over the water. Low morning light skims the crests of each ripple. Slow motion, quiet and meditative.
title: Ripple Rings

prompt: The navy ink cloud on the right billows towards the trailing pink threads on the left, and where they touch the two colours wind into fine purple filaments. The camera tracks slowly from right to left through the pale turquoise water. Backlight makes the thinnest strands glow. Super slow motion, graceful.
title: Ink Duel

prompt: Light races along the crossing tubes of the structure in pulses of pink and violet, each beam brightening in turn so the whole lattice appears to rotate. The camera looks up from below and turns slowly on its axis. The tubes cast a faint glow onto the black around them. Rhythmic, sharp, electric.
title: Laser Lattice

prompt: The cluster of purple particles twists like a flock, stretching into a ribbon, folding over and gathering back into a tight knot at the centre of the pale glow. The camera orbits the swarm at a steady distance. The halo behind it brightens whenever the cluster tightens. Slow, organic, otherworldly.
title: Violet Swarm

prompt: The flames in the dark fireplace lean and climb, licking along the top of the log and throwing off small sparks that rise and wink out. The camera creeps in from the side at hearth level. Orange firelight wavers across the sooty brick behind. Slow motion, warm and drowsy.
title: Hearth Flicker

prompt: The blue, green and orange powders rise out of their bowls in soft plumes, grains spiralling upward and mingling into a hanging haze of mixed colour above the table. The camera cranes up slowly with the dust. Gentle side light picks out the texture of every mound. Slow motion, festive and vivid.
title: Powder Lift

prompt: The white and red discs of out-of-focus light slide across the black frame as if seen from a moving car, overlapping and separating while fainter blue circles pass behind them. The camera pans slowly left. Each disc flares briefly at its rim. Slow, nocturnal, rain-on-the-window calm.
title: City Bokeh

prompt: The monochrome star trails turn in unison around the centre of the sky, lengthening into full circles above the dark tips of the pine trees. The camera tilts up a touch as the rotation builds. The arcs glow silver against the grey night. Time-lapse, stately and mesmerising.
title: Polar Spin

prompt: The white clouds boil and race over the skyline, their shadows sweeping across the towers and rooftops, while the big wheel in the middle distance spins in a blur. The camera pushes in slowly from the terrace. Sunlight flashes on and off the glass. Time-lapse, bright and brisk.
title: Cloud Rush

prompt: The curved grey terrain rolls around the frame like the inside of a bowl while the drone at the centre holds steady above the bright disc, its arms casting crisp shadows. The camera descends in a slow corkscrew. High-contrast monochrome light. Disorienting, clean, quietly eerie.
title: Planet Roll

prompt: Glitter peels away from the man's raised hands and coated face in a slow stream, the flakes floating off like sparks as he turns his fingers. The camera arcs gently around him in close-up. Warm light from one side makes every fleck flash copper and gold. Super slow motion, ritual and strange.
title: Glitter Shed

prompt: The heavy storm clouds churn and slide over the mountain range, curtains of rain dragging across the plain while the pale band at the horizon narrows. The camera rises slowly, as if from a drone. Shafts of grey light move over the land below. Time-lapse, brooding and wide.
title: Storm Roll

prompt: The grey, olive and black bands of paint slide past one another like strata under pressure, white veins bending into tight chevrons and then relaxing. The camera drifts diagonally across the surface from above. Soft light gives the ridges a wet shine. Slow, geological, absorbing.
title: Stone Marble

prompt: The dancers at the edges of the frame step inward on bare feet and their reflections ripple outward across the glossy teal floor in widening rings. The camera slides low along the ground between them. The vertical light tubes pulse softly behind. Slow motion, poised and atmospheric.
title: Mirror Floor

prompt: The skater's foot pushes down and the board shoots forward along the concrete, the pillars of the covered hall streaking past into motion blur behind his legs. The camera follows at knee height. Daylight from the open side strobes between the columns. Speed ramp, gritty and kinetic.
title: Push Off

prompt: The grid of pale dashes pours out of the blue centre and streaks down the green walls of the tunnel, lengthening as it nears the edges of the frame. The camera plunges forward and gradually rolls clockwise. The core glows and dims in a steady beat. Fast, digital, trance-like.
title: Lime Warp

prompt: The folded pink blooms loosen and open on the branch, petals unrolling outward while the green leaves lift and turn as if following the sun. The camera moves in a slow arc from the left bloom to the right. Clean light against the blue backdrop keeps the colours crisp. Time-lapse, fresh.
title: Petal Wake

prompt: The cream satin ripples as though a breeze has passed underneath, and the red, blue and gold confetti resting in its folds slides, flips and tumbles into the hollows. The camera drifts slowly down the fabric in close-up. Soft light glides along the sheen of each fold. Slow motion, elegant.
title: Satin Scatter

prompt: Water bursts over the dark rocks and breaks into a spray of glassy beads that hang in the air, the splash seeming to freeze for a beat before it collapses. The camera arcs slowly around the suspended droplets. Backlight turns each bead into a tiny lens. Bullet-time slow motion, crisp.
title: Splash Freeze

prompt: The cobalt blue currents sweep through the olive green in broad curving strokes, pulling thin threads of orange along with them as the whole pattern turns. The camera rotates gently above the surface. Glossy highlights travel along each band of colour. Slow, painterly, quietly dramatic.
title: Cobalt Swirl

prompt: The teal nodes pulse and send out fresh filaments of green light that arc between them, while the pink dashes shoot across the dark like signals passing along a wire. The camera weaves slowly through the network. Each node flares white at its core on every pulse. Alive, electric, microscopic.
title: Neon Spores

prompt: The golden particles explode outward from the centre in long forked arms, then slow, hang and drift back as a loose glittering dust. The camera pushes in through the falling specks. The bright core fades from white to deep amber against the dark. Slow motion, triumphant.
title: Gold Burst

prompt: The single small flame in the darkness twists, splits into two thin tongues and rejoins, shedding a few sparks that spiral away upward. The camera closes in very slowly from a distance. The flame is the only light, flickering between orange and white. Super slow motion, solitary and still.
title: Lone Flame

prompt: The orange powder in the nearest bowl erupts upward in a soft column, followed by the green and teal behind it, the three plumes merging overhead into a slow drifting haze. The camera tilts up from the bowls. Warm light glows through the dust. Slow motion, joyful and saturated.
title: Colour Plume

prompt: Along the horizon the strip of orange lights swells into soft round discs that drift and shimmer, mirrored faintly in the dark below, while the sky above deepens through blue. The camera pans slowly from left to right, never in focus. Warm against cool. Tranquil, blue-hour melancholy.
title: Dusk Glow

prompt: Between the overhanging branches the stars slide diagonally across the night, their streaks growing longer and denser until the gap in the canopy is filled with parallel lines. The camera stays fixed, looking straight up. A faint glow lights the leaves from below. Time-lapse, serene.
title: Canopy Trails

prompt: Traffic on the wide motorway below surges forward in pulses, lanes filling and emptying like a tide between the tower blocks, while cloud shadows sweep over the trees. The camera cranes up and tilts down over the road. Bright daylight flickers with each passing cloud. Time-lapse, busy and brisk.
title: Rush Hour Lapse

prompt: The small drone holds its place in the blue sky as the green hill beneath it swings round in a full sweeping orbit and the clouds slide past behind. The camera circles wide with the horizon tilting gently. Clear midday sun, soft cloud shadows on the slopes. Smooth, airy, expansive.
title: Hilltop Orbit

prompt: Gold glitter pours down from the top of the frame in a steady shower, thinning out as it falls and settling in a soft drift across the pale ground. The camera tilts down with the falling grains. Out-of-focus flakes glow as warm blurred discs. Slow motion, opulent and soft.
title: Glitter Cascade

prompt: The mound of white foam swells and creeps upward across the blue background, new bubbles inflating along its edge while older ones pop in tiny bursts. The camera pushes into a macro view of the froth. Clean light glints off each bubble wall. Time-lapse, clean and curious.
title: Foam Rise

prompt: The orange cells in the paint swell and split apart while the foamy white pool on the left spreads towards them, the blue streak between sliding through the black like oil. The camera drifts across the surface in extreme close-up. Wet highlights shimmer on every edge. Slow, vivid, microscopic.
title: Paint Cells

prompt: The silhouetted figure at the window stretches his arms wider across the frame as the city beyond brightens, light spilling in around his outline and streaking over the floor. The camera moves in slowly from behind. A flare blooms over his shoulder. Slow motion, contemplative and strong.
title: Dawn Flare

prompt: The skater at the left edge pushes off and rolls across the cracked asphalt, following the painted arrow, loose grit bouncing up from the wheels as he passes through the frame. The camera slides alongside just above the ground. Dull evening light flattens the tarmac. Slow motion, understated.
title: Asphalt Roll

prompt: The teal ink clouds heave upward out of the dark water, their rounded heads rolling over and budding into smaller curls that drift off to the right. The camera rises gently with the plumes. Cool side light gives each fold a soft velvet edge. Super slow motion, deep and silent.
title: Teal Billow

prompt: The thousands of blue bulbs lining the tunnel twinkle in waves that run from the entrance to the far end, the white ornamental scrolls on each side glowing brighter as the wave passes the lone walker. The camera glides forward along the path. Sparkling, wintry, full of wonder.
title: Twinkle Tunnel

prompt: The white bloom loosens its tight cup, outer petals folding back and the dark centre coming into view as the ferny green foliage around it stirs. The camera eases in to a close-up. Soft overcast light keeps the petals creamy with no hard shadow. Time-lapse, gentle and fresh.
title: White Unfurl

prompt: A gust lifts the heap of metallic confetti discs and sends them spinning up past the lens, each one flashing pink, gold, blue and green as it flips. The camera pulls back through the flying pieces. Bright light bounces off the foil in sharp glints. Slow motion, loud and festive.
title: Foil Flurry

prompt: The red-orange threads of ink coil upward through the water like slow flames, knotting and separating above the cool blue layer at the bottom of the frame. The camera rises with them in a tight vertical shot. Backlight makes the tendrils glow from within. Super slow motion, smouldering.
title: Red Tendrils

prompt: The glowing gold and pink loops spin around their shared centre, each ring tracing a full ellipse and leaving a bright trail that overlaps the last. The camera pushes slowly into the core. The centre burns near white while the outer rings cool to rose. Hypnotic, rhythmic, radiant.
title: Light Loops

prompt: The bright core flares and throws out a shell of pink and green sparks that expand through the dark, slow down and float like embers. The camera pulls back to keep the widening ring in frame. Light from the centre rakes across the nearest particles. Slow motion, explosive then calm.
title: Spark Nova

prompt: Flames wrap around the stacked logs and a stream of embers lifts off the glowing pink coals, drifting up and across the frame on the heat. The camera moves in low towards the fire. Flickering orange light pushes back the surrounding dark. Slow motion, crackling and close.
title: Ember Drift

prompt: The hands come together and a puff of pale powder bursts out from between the palms, spreading into a fine cloud that hangs in front of the white T-shirt. The camera holds a tight shot at chest level. Cool even light against the blue background shows every grain. Super slow motion, focused.
title: Chalk Clap

prompt: The vertical stack of blurred lights flickers and trembles in the dark, the warm white discs swelling while the small green and violet ones drift up and fade. The camera racks focus slowly without settling. Faint halos spread into the blackness around them. Quiet, late, slightly uneasy.
title: Light Flicker

prompt: Behind the tall pine the stars sweep across the deep blue sky in long parallel arcs, turning around the treetop as if it were the axle. The camera looks up from the ground with a wide lens and does not move. Warm light glows on the trunk and foliage. Time-lapse, majestic.
title: Pine Star Wheel

prompt: Vehicles curve through the junction below as continuous threads of red and white light, sweeping around the bends and past the palm trees in overlapping loops. The camera rotates slowly overhead. Yellow streetlight pools on the tarmac and the verges glow green. Hyperlapse, smooth and urban.
title: Junction Streaks

prompt: The patchwork of golden fields and dark hedgerows turns slowly beneath the horizon as the drone in the sky stays pinned in place, long shadows sliding over the crops. The camera arcs in a wide aerial circle. Low evening sun warms everything amber. Calm, sweeping, open.
title: Farmland Orbit

prompt: The gold glitter heart shimmers and then sheds its grains outward in a soft ring, joining the loose swirls of glitter already scattered across the white surface. The camera lowers slowly from directly above. Warm light sets off quick flashes in the gold. Slow motion, sweet and romantic.
title: Heart Sparkle

prompt: The tightly packed bubbles shift against each other, walls snapping and re-forming so the whole web of circles rearranges itself cell by cell. The camera moves slowly across the foam in macro. Strong white backlight draws every membrane as a fine dark line. Mesmerising, clinical, strangely alive.
title: Bubble Lattice

prompt: Lightning flickers inside the purple cloud mass and a thin fork darts out to the left of the dark rooftop, the whole sky pulsing bright and dim in quick succession. The camera stays fixed at street level. Violet light washes over the treeline. Slow motion, dramatic and heavy.
title: Lightning Fork

prompt: The orange and yellow bands creep across the frame like molten rock, folding into tight swirls where the currents meet and stretching thin where they pull apart. The camera tracks slowly with the flow from overhead. The brightest streaks seem to glow from within. Slow, hot, viscous.
title: Lava Flow

prompt: The dancer rises onto her toes and turns, pink light trailing from her arms and legs in soft ribbons that linger in the black behind her. The camera circles her in the opposite direction at full length. A single coloured spotlight follows the spin. Slow motion, graceful and intense.
title: Spotlight Spin

prompt: The skater leans into the turn and carves up the curved ramp on the right, wheels kicking out a puff of dust at the top before he drops back down. The camera chases close behind with a wide lens that warps the pale building beyond. Flat grey daylight. Speed ramp, fluid and urban.
title: Ramp Carve

prompt: The rust-coloured cloud blooms outward from its pale centre in rounded lobes, each one swelling, darkening and folding under the next. The camera pushes slowly into the bright core. Light from behind glows through the thinnest parts in amber. Super slow motion, volcanic and brooding.
title: Rust Cloud

prompt: The rings of pink and teal panels rotate in alternating directions as they slide past, the pattern narrowing endlessly towards the dark centre. The camera falls steadily down the middle of the shaft. Colour ripples from ring to ring like a pulse. Hypnotic, geometric, vertiginous.
title: Kaleido Tunnel

prompt: The pink-edged rose opens layer by layer, outer petals curling back and the tight heart loosening while the sepals beneath droop away. The camera rises slowly from the stem to the flower head. Soft studio light keeps the grey background smooth and even. Time-lapse, tender and refined.
title: Rose Unfurl

prompt: A breath of air sweeps the dark round discs across the pale surface, some skidding out of frame and others flipping over to leave only their soft shadows behind. The camera glides low in shallow focus. Monochrome side light stretches each shadow long. Slow motion, minimal and graphic.
title: Disc Scatter

prompt: Citrus slices drop into the bright blue pool and punch a crown of water upward, rings racing outward and scrambling the net of sunlight on the tiles below. The camera looks straight down and sinks slowly towards the splash. Hard sun glitters on every ripple. Slow motion, crisp and summery.
title: Pool Plunge

prompt: Violet and white ink sweeps diagonally through the red and orange water in long feathered strokes, while the small dark bubble at the left rides the current and slowly turns. The camera drifts with the flow from corner to corner. Strong backlight sets the pale streaks ablaze. Super slow motion, fiery.
title: Sunset Ink

prompt: The sparkler spits a widening spray of gold sparks, each one forking into finer branches before it dies, as the coloured lights behind swell and shrink in soft discs. The camera holds a close shot with shallow focus. Warm sparks flare against cool red, green and blue blur. Slow motion, festive and bright.
title: Sparkler Fizz

prompt: White surf surges over the pebbles and flings the smallest stones into the air, then drains back through the gaps and leaves the beach glistening. The camera sits just above the shingle and slides back with the retreating water. Bright daylight sparkles in the foam. Slow motion, fresh and tactile.
title: Foam Retreat

prompt: The ballerina spins with one arm raised and her pale tulle skirt lifts into a wide floating disc, its layers rippling a beat behind the turn. The camera orbits her slowly at waist height. Soft window light fills the studio and glows through the fabric. Slow motion, airy and romantic.
title: Tulle Whirl

prompt: Inside the three hourglasses the sand stops falling, hangs as a thin thread, then streams upward into the top bulbs grain by grain. The camera tracks slowly across the row from left to right. Sunlight through the garden behind glints on the curved glass. Reverse slow motion, uncanny and calm.
title: Sand Reversal

prompt: The scattered pink rose petals lift off the pale surface and circle in a loose spiral, turning over in the air to show their lighter undersides before settling again. The camera descends slowly from overhead. Even soft light leaves only faint shadows beneath each petal. Slow motion, gentle and sweet.
title: Petal Swirl

prompt: The lemon slice breaks through the waterline and sinks, dragging a column of silver bubbles that wobble, split and race back up to the surface. The camera holds a level shot half above and half below the water. Side light makes every bubble shine against the black. Extreme slow motion, clean and sharp.
title: Citrus Dive

prompt: The teal and crimson streaks seep outward across the cream surface, feathering into fine veins that branch, meet and blend into soft violet. The camera glides slowly along the band of colour in close-up. Flat diffused light keeps the pigments translucent. Time-lapse, delicate and painterly.
title: Watercolour Bleed
